spec: B-100X1 as run by Squad 4 (squad4-lab.mjs, specified 24 Oct 2026 before the run): WINNER = a stock whose close HELD 5x (or 10x) a starting close for 20 sessions (lowest close of 20 sessions, 15+ present), starting from any session at which it closed >= 2 USD with 20-session average volume >= 200k shares, within the 5-year data (adjusted prices; delisted stocks included; a path with a near-whole 3x-50x one-day jump = unadjusted split is ignored). SNAPSHOTS at the month starts 12, 6 and 3 months before the start of the move (the low it rose from) and at the start: revenue growth and acceleration, gross margin and trend, R&D intensity, market cap, 12-month return percentile, distance from the 52-week high, industry (SIC), officer/director ownership, share count change. LOOK-ALIKES: every eligible stock at the same month start with the same visible profile bucket (revenue growth band, 12-month return tercile, market-cap band, gross-margin trend), followed to the end of the data: how many reached 5x, how many died. PRECISION: monthly panel Oct 2022 - Sep 2024, each eligible stock followed 2 years (504 sessions): for each pre-listed profile the share that reached sustained 5x / 10x, the share that died or fell 80%+, lift over all stocks. A study, not a buy rule; no profile is re-fitted on these winners.

GROWLEAD.name: the SQ4-GROWLEAD profile (+ within 5% of the 52-week high)

SMALL-GROW-GM.name: market cap under 2B, revenue +25%+, gross margin 40%+

IPO-DOUBLE.name: listed 2-5 years and revenue doubled in 2 years
